name: Card
description: Composable card (media, header, action, content, footer): outline, elevated, ghost and muted variants, plus a fully clickable card.
useWhen: Related content must be grouped in a bordered or elevated surface with header, body and footer
A grid of articles, projects or resources where each whole card links to a detail page
A dashboard tile shows one key figure with its trend next to a label

avoidWhen.when: The card represents a product with price, variants, wishlist and quick add
Cards should open into a detail view in place instead of navigating away
A landing page needs an asymmetric feature grid with spanning tiles and visuals

classes.name: mv-card-header / -title / -description / -action
classes.description: Header; -action sits at the top right.

classes.name: mv-card-footer
classes.description: Footer; data-bordered for a separated, tinted footer.

classes.name: mv-card-link
classes.description: Link stretched over the whole card (with data-interactive).

attributes.name: data-interactive
attributes.description: Lift on hover, media zoom, focus ring.

a11y: Clickable card: a single link (.mv-card-link) in the title; other controls stay reachable on top (z-index).
